protocols.description: DEC-0067: the protocol revisions this service accepts, N and N−1 per protocol. A request in another revision is refused with schema-unsupported before it is read.

id.description: The service's id; it equals the descriptor's, or a host reports the port's holder as foreign (FAC-SEM-009, docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

instance.description: The instance; it equals the descriptor's (FAC-SEM-009, docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

name.description: The service's name as a host shows it, 1 to 80 characters (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

version.description: The running version, a semantic version (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

commit.description: The source commit the build was made from, 7 to 40 lower-case hex digits (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

digest.description: The package digest of the build (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

dirty.description: True when the build carries changes that are not in the commit (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

builtAt.description: When the build was made, an RFC 3339 date-time (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

build.description: The running build: a commit or a package digest, so a host tells a restart onto new code from one onto old code (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

service.description: Which service answers: id and instance equal to its descriptor's, its name, version and build (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

pid.description: The process id; a host compares it with the supervisor's to detect a second copy (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

startedAt.description: When the process started, an RFC 3339 date-time (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

process.description: The live process: its pid and when it started; a host compares the pid with its supervisor's (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

status.description: starting, ready, degraded or stopping; a process that cannot serve does not answer, and the host derives down (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

source.description: What is degraded, 1 to 80 characters; equal to a connection's id it is that connection failing (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document, docs/specification/connections.md).

reason.description: Why, in one line of 1 to 300 characters; for a setup state, what the person does (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

setup.description: DEC-0044. true: the source waits for a person to finish setting it up (a key not entered, a model not chosen); it is not an outage, and a watcher does not alert on it. Absent or false: the source is failing.

degraded.description: What does not work now, always present: an empty list asserts full health, and ready with entries is inconsistent (FAC-SEM-011, docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

value.description: The tile's value: a number or a string of at most 40 characters (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

attention.description: True when the tile asks for the operator (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

summary.description: At most six tiles for a host's card (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

path.description: The dashboard's path on the service origin (docs/specification/service.md#operator-login).

login.description: True when the dashboard requires an operator session begun with a login code (docs/specification/service.md#operator-login).

dashboard.description: The dashboard page and whether it requires an operator session (docs/specification/service.md#operator-login).

path.description: The MCP surface's path on the service origin (docs/specification/service.md#surfaces).

capabilities.description: The capability names the surface serves, so a host shows them without the token; the manifest remains the authority (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

auth.description: DEC-0024, DEC-0039. descriptor (default): the MCP surface takes the descriptor's token in its header. own: it authenticates its callers with credentials of its own (a token per agent, a gateway's caller identity); the descriptor's token is the host's and is not an MCP credential. delegation: it takes only the estate's delegation tokens (auth.delegation), and the descriptor's token is not an MCP credential.

mcp.description: The MCP surface: its path, its transport, the capabilities it serves and the credential it takes (docs/specification/service.md#surfaces, docs/specification/service.md#mcp-credentials).

path.description: The events feed's path on the service origin (docs/specification/service.md#events-feed).

stream.description: The path of the events feed's stream, when it has one (docs/specification/service.md#events-feed).

path.description: The usage report's path on the service origin (docs/specification/service.md#usage-report).

operatorChannel.description: DEC-0034. Where the service answers its operator-channel status (fabric-operator-channel/0.1); token-protected like the events feed.

path.description: The operator-channel status's path on the service origin; it requires the service token (docs/specification/operator-channel.md, docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

surfaces.description: The paths the service serves on its origin; the events feed is required (docs/specification/service.md#surfaces).

auth.description: DEC-0039. How the service authenticates calls beyond the descriptor's token.

delegation.description: The service accepts the estate's delegation tokens (fabric-delegation/0.1): Authorization: Bearer on a direct call, Fabric-Delegation on a call the hub forwards.

issuer.description: The iss it trusts: the estate hub.

jwks.description: Where it reads the estate's public keys (the hub's /.well-known/jwks.json, or the copy Fabric publishes).

configuration.description: DEC-0046. What the operator can configure for this agent, and what applies now — read-only: a change is made in Fabric and reaches the agent through its binding, never through this document.

slots.description: The configurable slots: the runner, the model, or both.

resolved.description: The profiles that apply now, after the resolution order (request, agent, binding or project, estate default) and the project's model classes.

from.description: The level the resolved profiles came from: the request, the agent, the binding or the estate (docs/specification/runners.md#resolution).

runnerProfile.description: The runner profile that applies now (docs/specification/runners.md#what-an-agent-declares).

runnerKind.description: That runner profile's runner kind, a slug (docs/specification/runners.md#what-an-agent-declares).

route.description: That runner profile's route: subscription or key (docs/specification/runners.md#routes).

modelProfile.description: The model profile that applies now (docs/specification/runners.md#what-an-agent-declares).

models.description: The profile's models the project's classes admit, first choice first.

available.description: A newer version the service knows about, or null (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

update.description: Whether a newer version is known (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).

extensions.description: Extension values keyed by URI, such as the embedded dashboard's and the connections declaration (docs/specification/service.md#well-known-document).
